filter.name: fpos
filter.formula: favg9(i) > 0, favg9(i) = arithmetic mean of the last 9 Binance USDT-M funding-rate settlements (GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate, fundingTime floored to the minute) with fundingTime <= open_time of bar i
filter.bar_used: bar i = the signal bar; settlements at or before bar i's OPEN only (a settlement that happens exactly at bar i's close / bar i+1's open is NOT used for bar i's signal)

entry.trigger: entry edge at close of bar i iff st(i) AND NOT st(i-1)  (fires on the death cross while filter true, OR when the filter turns true while ema_fast already < ema_slow)
entry.preconditions: slot flat after bar i's own stop processing (a stop-out on bar i still allows an entry signal at bar i's close); no pending exit; ATR14(i) > 0; bar i >= 2023-09-24 in backtest

fill.entry: SELL (open short) at OPEN of bar i+1; backtest fill price = open(i+1) * (1 - 0.0020)
fill.signal_exit_or_max_hold: BUY reduce-only at OPEN of the next bar; backtest fill = open * (1 + 0.0020)
fill.stop: BUY at max(open(j), stop) of the bar j where high(j) >= stop; backtest fill = max(open, stop) * (1 + 0.0020)

stop.initial: stop0 = entry_fill_price + 2.0 * ATR14(signal bar i), where entry_fill_price = open(i+1)*(1-0.0020) (cost-adjusted, as in engine)
stop.active_from: the fill bar itself (checked intrabar on bar i+1 using its High)
stop.trail: after each closed bar j in position that was NOT stopped (incl. the fill bar): stop = min(stop, close(j) + 5.0 * ATR14(j)); only ever moves down (never loosened); new level applies from bar j+1
stop.trigger: high(j) >= stop (last-price kline high; stop level as of close of bar j-1)

exit_signal: close of bar j: ema9(j) > ema21(j) (strict) -> exit at open(j+1). Filter is NOT used for exit.
max_hold_rule: at close of bar j, if (j - fill_bar_index) >= 60 -> exit at open(j+1); fill bar = index 0, so max 61 bars in position
bar_processing_order: 1 funding settlement(s) mapped to this bar's open applied to open position
2 pending exit filled at open
3 pending entry filled at open (stop0 set)
4 stop check: high >= stop -> exit at max(open, stop)
5 liquidation check (isolated, maint 0.5%)
6 trail update with this bar's close/ATR
7 exit_signal, else max_hold -> pending exit
8 if flat & entry edge & ATR>0 -> pending entry
cooldown: none; after any exit a NEW entry edge (st false -> true) is required; st staying true after a stop-out does not re-enter

funding: each settlement (rate r, fundingTime t floored to minute) is mapped to the first bar with open_time >= t; if a position is open at that bar's open (before that bar's pending exit), pnl += qty * open(bar) * r (short RECEIVES when r>0, pays when r<0).
